messages:
sara: Anyone else noticed an uptick in 'partial_frame' / 'incomplete_frame' events from EU edges this morning? Console graph spiked around 02:42 UTC.
ben: Yup. Started ~02:40. Clients report socket closing mid-stream while server logs show incomplete_frame and immediate close. Mostly small frames (~200-800B).
priya: I correlate that with an LB agent config flip at 02:37 (image rollout). Could be a proxy buffering/flush change.
sara: Sample log from eu-edge-4 at 02:41:08:
```
[02:41:08.341] ws:accept conn=xyz987 remote=54.12.34.56
[02:41:08.345] ws:read conn=xyz987 err=read: connection reset by peer
[02:41:08.345] stream:incomplete_frame conn=xyz987 bytes=512 partial=true
[02:41:08.345] ws:close conn=xyz987 reason=partial_frame
```
ben: Notable: read error is a reset by peer, not timeout. If proxy sends FIN mid-frame we see zero-length read and classify as partial.
mike: deploy-bot: LB agent rollout: v2.14.1 -> v2.14.2 @ 02:37:21, health checks passed. There was a brief rollback to v2.14.1 @ 02:39:10 but agent reconciled to 2.14.2 at 02:40:55.
priya: Hypothesis: new agent aggressively flushes TCP FIN on idle connection close that races with fragmented websocket frames. When client and backend fragment timing collide the backend sees a reset during read and treats it as incomplete.
ben: Quick mitigation idea: make server's ws handler tolerant to a single zero-length read during frame assembly: do a non-blocking small retry (50ms) before marking incomplete. Opened hotfix branch: git.redwood/infer/pr/10023 (ws-zero-read-retry).
sara: Good. Also, we need better telemetry labels: current metric stream_incomplete_frame_total lacks edge_agent_version and proxy_buffer_config. Add both so we can filter.
mike: I'll add a temporary Grafana card and a Pager alert (2h window) to catch regressions during canary. Proposed alert rule:
```
expr: sum(rate(stream_incomplete_frame_total{region=\"eu\"}[5m])) by (edge_instance) > 2
for: 5m
```
priya: Add tracing tags: edge_agent_version, proxy_buffer_bytes, client_user_agent. Also annotate traces with whether LB had a recent reconcile (reconcile=true) to correlate rollbacks.
ben: We should also run an integration test that injects `tc qdisc` jitter and forces `FIN` during small fragmented writes to validate fix. I'll add a test case to stream-integration.
sara: Who can push the canary? Let's limit to eu-edge-canary pool and watch for duplicate frames or reassembly errors. If that goes well promote in 1 hour.
ben: I'll own the canary and monitor metrics. Adding a new metric stream_partial_frame_retry_total for visibility.
mike: deploy-bot: canary deploy: ws-zero-read-retry -> eu-edge-canary (2026.03.21-rc3)
sara: Console UX ask: add a pre-filtered view that shows stream_incomplete_frame_total by edge_agent_version, proxy_buffer_bytes, and client_user_agent. Also include a one-click link to trace explorer with the last 50 incomplete_frame traces.
priya: Follow-ups: 1) add labels to the metric, 2) add trace tags for 48h, 3) integration test for mid-frame FIN, 4) postmortem checklist item if rollback needed.
ben: If canary doesn't reduce the rate by >=70% after 30m we rollback. If duplicate frames appear >0.5% of streams we rollback immediately.
sara: Thanks. We'll sync in 40m in #eng-platform.
